title: Simultaneous clopen lisse trivialization and complete restriction
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and residue field $k=R/(\varpi)$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme] work on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and put $R_{n,T}=(R/\varpi^n)_T$ and $B_T=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}R_{n,T}$, using constant sheaves and inverse limits [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Use the unbounded derived category $D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_T))$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. A complex $M$ is quotient-tower complete if its canonical quotient maps exhibit it as $R\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(M\otimes^L_{B_T}R_{n,T})$, with the quotient transitions and with the terms restricted to $B_T$-scalars [def-weil-derived-limit, def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Assume that $T$ is affine and evaluation at $T$ sends every epimorphism of sheaves of sets to a surjection. Let $J$ be a finite set and, for each $j\in J$, let $F_j$ be a locally constant sheaf of $k_T$-modules with finite-dimensional $k$-module local models [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf]. There is a finite partition $T=\coprod_i U_i$ by clopen subschemes, meaning open subschemes whose underlying subsets are closed [def-weil-open-immersion], such that $F_j|_{U_i}\cong k_{U_i}^{\oplus r_{ij}}$ for finite integers $r_{ij}\geq0$. Each $U_i$ is quasi-compact and evaluation on $U_i$ sends epimorphisms of sheaves of sets to surjections. For every sheaf $C$ of commutative rings on $(U_i)_{\mathrm{proet}}$, evaluation $\Gamma(U_i,-)$ on $C$-module sheaves is exact, and $C^{\oplus r}$ is a projective object for every finite $r$: maps from it lift along epimorphisms. Moreover $B_T|_{U_i}\cong B_{U_i}$ canonically. Ordinary restriction to $U_i$ preserves quotient-tower completeness and commutes with derived reductions, with the canonical quotient projections and their reduction transitions. If $M_1=M\otimes^L_{B_T}k_T$ has Tor amplitude $[a,b]$ after restriction to every site object, then $(M|_{U_i})\otimes^L_{B_{U_i}}k_{U_i}$ has the same amplitude. Here Tor amplitude means vanishing of $H^q(-\otimes^L_{k_V}L)$ for $q\notin[a,b]$, for every site object $V$ and every degree-zero $k_V$-module sheaf $L$ [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude, def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. The empty partition is allowed for $T=\varnothing$.

proof.text: Obtain the simultaneous finite clopen free partition from lem-sf-clopen-lisse-partition, using the residue field structure supplied by the maximal ideal of the coefficient DVR. For each piece use lem-sf-clopen-cover-geometry to inherit categorical weak contractibility in the original and independent coefficient universes. Apply lem-sf-weakly-contractible-projective to each arbitrary commutative ring sheaf. Construct the normalized coefficient datum by lem-sf-clopen-coefficient-comparison and complete it by lem-sf-clopen-derived-compatibility. Assemble the conjunctions with the chosen free models.
